name: deckaura-tarot
description: Explore all 78 tarot cards with upright, reversed, love, career, yes-or-no meanings, card draws, and spreads.
long_description: A local Model Context Protocol server backed by Deckaura's complete 78-card structured tarot dataset. No account, API key, network connection, or paid subscription is required.

tools.name: get_card_meaning
tools.description: Get structured upright, reversed, love, career, yes-or-no, zodiac, and guide data for a tarot card.

tools.name: draw_random_card
tools.description: Draw one random card from the complete 78-card deck.

tools.name: three_card_spread
tools.description: Draw a three-card past, present, and future spread.

tools.name: yes_no_reading
tools.description: Draw a card and return its structured yes, no, or maybe tendency.

tools.name: list_all_cards
tools.description: List every card in the complete 78-card deck.
